1.1.1 # of outpatient consultations supported by health partners (excluding mental health, trauma consultations, and physical rehabilitation) **Definition: This indicator should include all outpatient consultations supported by humanitarian actors. 1.1.4 # of physical rehabilitation sessions supported **Definition: This indicator includes all physical rehabilitation sessions provided through health facilities or mobile medical units supported by humanitarian actors.
